security_audit.summary: AI review found no prompt-injection attempt or malware intent in the skill prose. Most static hits are false positives from Markdown, CSS relative asset paths, template literals, license text, WebP assets, and checksum strings. Confirmed risks are intentional execution and network surfaces: rendering tools, media helpers, optional web asset fetching, remote template resources, Mapbox token-bearing URLs, and temporary files.

remediation.issue: Third-party resources load during template rendering.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle fonts and icon scripts locally, pin versions, or add integrity checks before rendering untrusted task HTML.

remediation.issue: Web-sourced asset workflow imports unverified media.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user consent for each source, validate file type and size, and keep provenance in task-local files.

remediation.issue: Video helpers execute ffmpeg and ffprobe on user-provided media.
remediation.suggestion: Document prerequisites, restrict inputs to task folders, and warn users not to process untrusted videos in sensitive workspaces.

remediation.issue: Live Photo documentation writes caches and checks under /private/tmp.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer task-local cache and output directories, or clean temporary artifacts after packaging.

remediation.issue: Mapbox examples place access tokens in image URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Use restricted tokens, avoid committing generated HTML with tokens, and remove token-bearing URLs from shared artifacts.

content.value_statement: Social posts need strong visual structure, not generic title cards. This skill turns articles, screenshots, photos, and short videos into platform-ready card sets.
actual_capabilities: Plans Xiaohongshu and Rednote 3:4 carousel pages from source text.
Builds WeChat 21:9 and 1:1 cover pairs in one HTML preview.
Provides Editorial and Swiss seed templates with theme tokens.
Handles screenshot framing, map components, and web-sourced image provenance.
Documents Live Photo workflows for single, puzzle, triple, and long-video intake.
Includes a Playwright-based layout validator for rendered posters.
limitations: It needs user-approved assets or browsing for real photos.
It is not a full slide deck or long-video editing skill.
Live Photo publishing still depends on mobile platform support.
Generated HTML may load external fonts or CDN scripts unless assets are localized.

use_cases.title: Turn Articles Into Rednote Carousels
use_cases.description: Convert a long article into a cover and supporting image pages with clear hierarchy and platform-safe dimensions.

use_cases.title: Package Product Updates For Social Channels
use_cases.description: Create Swiss-style cards that explain features, metrics, screenshots, and comparisons for product launches or tool reviews.

use_cases.title: Create WeChat Cover Pairs
use_cases.description: Design a consistent 21:9 main cover and 1:1 share cover from the same story without cropping one ratio into another.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Rednote Carousel
prompt_templates.scenario: The user has an article and wants a simple social card set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-page Rednote carousel from this article. Use the Swiss style, keep each page focused on one idea, and ask once if you need photos.

prompt_templates.title: Editorial Story Cards
prompt_templates.scenario: The user wants a slower magazine-style visual story.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this travel note into an Editorial Magazine card set. Use one strong cover image, concise captions, and a page plan before rendering.

prompt_templates.title: WeChat Cover Pair
prompt_templates.scenario: The user needs both WeChat cover sizes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a WeChat cover pair for this article: one 21:9 main cover and one 1:1 share cover. Keep the visual system consistent and shorten the square title.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Live Photo Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: The user has short video assets and wants motion cards.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these three short videos to plan a Live Photo card workflow. Inspect the first frames, choose single or triple layout, and document the output package paths.

output_examples.input: A product review article with two dashboard screenshots.
output: A five-page Rednote carousel plan with a Swiss visual system.
Rendered poster images with framed screenshots and readable labels.
A short delivery note listing dimensions and validation status.

output_examples.input: A long essay title for a WeChat article.
output: A 21:9 main cover using the full title and one strong visual relationship.
A 1:1 share cover using a shorter title and matching theme.
A combined preview for checking the pair together.

output_examples.input: Three short coffee process videos for Rednote.
output: A Live Photo layout recommendation based on the motion role.
A first-frame static preview for crop and text checks.
Packaging guidance for JPG, MOV, and phone publishing paths.

best_practices: Provide real screenshots, photos, or videos when visual evidence matters.
Choose one visual system per package, either Editorial or Swiss.
Review image source provenance before publishing downloaded assets.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for full slide decks or long-form video editing.
Do not ask it to fake product data, release facts, or percentages.
Do not publish web-sourced images without checking rights and attribution needs.

faq.question: Which platforms does this skill support?
faq.answer: It targets Rednote and Xiaohongshu carousels, WeChat cover pairs, article covers, thumbnails, and short Live Photo card workflows.

faq.question: Can it create final images?
faq.answer: Yes, when the agent environment supports file writing and browser rendering. It uses HTML and CSS templates to render platform-sized images.

faq.question: Does it need my own photos or screenshots?
faq.answer: Your own assets give the best result. If none are available, the workflow can use generated or web-sourced images with your approval.

faq.question: Can it make Live Photos?
faq.answer: It documents Live Photo card workflows for supplied videos, including first-frame checks, MOV output, and phone publishing notes.

faq.question: What visual styles are included?
faq.answer: It includes an Editorial Magazine style and a Swiss International style, each with fixed themes, ratios, and layout recipes.

faq.question: What should users review before running it?
faq.answer: Review external downloads, browser rendering, local scripts, and video inputs. Run it in a trusted workspace with only needed files.
